card.name: Punctuation and links before ALL-CAPS headings
card.fires_on: Small joining or punctuation marks ("and", "?", "/") and parts of words that sit inside or just before an ALL-CAPS section name or label. Seen in cross-references like "see CONTRAINDICATIONS and WARNINGS" and in capitalized notices.

modes.label: Cross-reference links
modes.description: The word "and" between capitalized label sections in "see X and Y" references.

modes.label: Inside capitalized words
modes.description: Partway through a word in an all-caps sentence.
modes.example: THIS IS DOCUMENTATION FOR AN OBSO<<LETE>> PRODUCT.

modes.label: Logic-style variable marks
modes.description: A question mark in formal rule notation before an upper-case variable.

card.writes: It pushes toward capitalized label-like words such as FILE, INPUT, RESULTS and CONTEXT, and away from name-like pieces.
card.plain: It fires on joining marks next to capitalized section names, where another capitalized label usually comes next.
